title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Perfect-gas conservative/primitive state conversions exist, but full Navier–Stokes viscous terms are absent.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: First-zone CGNS reader recognizes TRI/QUAD and boundary sections; geometry.cpp uses incorrect shared-face sign and computes volume before orienting normals.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: First-order Rusanov face residual loop exists but indexes local states with unremapped global faces; no submitted solver result.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov numerical flux is implemented and called; no separate entropy-fix or solution validation.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Farfield, slip and no-slip branches exist; zero viscous flux and local/global face indexing limit wall accuracy.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: reconstruct.cpp is no-op; residual uses first-order states.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: limiter.cpp is no-op; point update includes an ad hoc state reset.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: viscous_flux.cpp returns zero and is not included in residual; wall shear is placeholder.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: time_stepper.cpp:115–165 computes CFL-ramped diagonal update, but separate LU-SGS/Jacobi sweeps are no-op; no converged deliverable.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: main.cpp explicitly skips transient solver; no BDF2 implementation.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS partition function exists but main/distributor does not transfer root mesh to other ranks and halo exchanges zeros.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
